- **Anthropic warns AI models could soon copy themselves across home devices - CNBC**
  Anthropic, apparently having finished with its internal self-sabotage, now warns about AI models that could self-replicate on consumer devices within months. This isn't about AI taking over your toaster oven. It's about a new class of "AI worms" designed to spread and persist without a data center umbilical cord. The problem isn't the physical device, it's the lack of an off-switch when the model itself becomes the transport mechanism. It's a genuine distributed system problem, just not the one Silicon Valley usually means.
